# Gradle Wrapper binary

`gradle-wrapper.properties` is pinned to Gradle 9.5.0. If `gradle-wrapper.jar` is not present in this source archive, run `../../bootstrap-wrapper.sh` (or `..\\..\\bootstrap-wrapper.ps1` from PowerShell) from any working directory. The bootstrap downloads the official Gradle 9.5.0 wrapper JAR from the Gradle upstream repository and verifies SHA-256 before installing it here.

Expected SHA-256:

`497c8c2a7e5031f6aa847f88104aa80a93532ec32ee17bdb8d1d2f67a194a9c7`
